verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any in-console feature that uses AI to generate insights or suggestions from a user's Statsig data. The closest item is the official MCP server, which lets external AI clients such as Cursor or Claude Code query Statsig data. That is a different, adjacent capability, since the AI runs outside the product. Autotune's bandit allocation and the AI-model experimentation integrations are also not AI-generated insights inside the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
